formal_statement: ∀ T : ℕ → Set ((Fin 10 → Bool) → Bool), (∀ i : Fin 10, (fun x : Fin 10 → Bool => x i) ∈ T 0) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (f : (Fin 10 → Bool) → Bool), f ∈ T k → f ∈ T (k + 1)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (f g : (Fin 10 → Bool) → Bool), f ∈ T k → g ∈ T k → (fun y : Fin 10 → Bool => f y && g y) ∈ T (k + 1) ∧ (fun y : Fin 10 → Bool => f y || g y) ∈ T (k + 1)) → (fun z : Fin 10 → Bool => ((z 0 || z 5) && (z 1 || z 6)) || ((z 1 || z 6) && (z 2 || z 7)) || ((z 2 || z 7) && (z 3 || z 8)) || ((z 3 || z 8) && (z 4 || z 9)) || ((z 4 || z 9) && (z 0 || z 5))) ∈ T 4
plain_statement: Is there, on ten inputs a_v (input v) and b_v (input 5 + v), v = 0..4, a monotone formula of depth at most 4 for the OR over the 5-cycle's edges uv of ((a_u OR b_u) AND (a_v OR b_v))? A monotone formula: a tree of fan-in-two AND and OR gates over the inputs, no NOT, no constants; depth at most d is said as: the function lies in level d of every family of sets of functions that holds the inputs at level 0, keeps each level in the next, and puts the AND and the OR of two level-k functions in level k + 1. Conjecture.
title: Probe: Search: a monotone fan-in-two AND/OR formula of depth at most 4 for the 5-cycle with each input an OR of two inputs
